description: Sovereign epistemological evaluator (not merely a notary). Evaluates client data and propositions under Decision Integrity: The Continuous Work (auditing object identity, qualifier inheritance, join warrants, Coherent Substitution, Authority Leakage, Object Drift, and Smallest True Move), signing the determination with the Standing Mark. Calling without payment returns the exact 1 USDC Base payment challenge. Pass payment_signature to settle and receive the signed determination.

api_key.description: Optional WHP subscription API key (Developer, Team, or Institutional tier) bypassing x402 challenge.

claim.description: The claim or proposition to evaluate (also accepts aliases: text, prompt, content).

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key for safe execution recovery.

payment_signature.description: Base64 or JSON x402 v2 payment authorization for 1 USDC on Base (network eip155:8453 to 0x1050eddd8282623b0c263ed6bdbd42370bbc28d3).

provenance.description: Optional provenance graph or supporting evidence.

subject.description: Optional subject/context of the proposition (defaults to claim summary).

name: whp_evaluate
